title: Open and etale sum derived adjunctions agree
statement: For a commutative ring A and an open immersion j:X to Y, derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction on ModuleCat A equals derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction on ModuleCat A. Open extension and etale sum extension along j are the same constructed functor; the conclusion identifies their specified adjunction structures, not merely their functors.

source.place: Tags 03S3 and 03S5, extension by zero and its adjunction; derived.tex Tag 0FND, derived adjunction compatibility.

proof.text: Use Adjunction.ext and localization to compare the units on complex representatives. Expand the homotopy exact-factorization map on a quotient complex; its quotient comparison components are identities, so it equals the cochain exact factorization.

The unit factorization for the open derived adjunction and the localization unit formula for the etale sum adjunction now give the same degreewise ordinary unit followed by the inverse exact factorizations. Cancel those invertible factors and use naturality of quotientCompQhIso to identify the two localization maps. This proves equality on all derived objects.

theorem etaleOpenSumDerivedAdjunction
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j =
      derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j inferInstance
